patch_description: This approach converts a target maximum KVPR into a feasibility problem. For a candidate pressure threshold T, every model consumes transformed capacity `demand + T * model_size` from a GPU capacity of `T * GPU_MEM_SIZE`, while also respecting physical memory. The algorithm binary-searches the smallest feasible threshold and uses multi-order best-fit packing at each threshold. This directly optimizes the minimax KVPR objective rather than relying on local move or swap improvements from a greedy placement.
